messages:
tara: trade veto drama alert. hugo and mike just proposed a 3-for-1 that feels... extremely lopsided. :eyes:

hugo: it's fair value, proven by power rankings. also free breakfast if veto fails. :grimacing:

mike: wink wink i just need a WR4 to patch injury holes. i'll throw in pizza next week.

tara: pizza isnt the point mike. this affects playoff parity. anyone opposed to a quick poll?

anya: poll: veto this trade?
1) Yes veto 
2) No let it through
3) Force arbitration (tara)

tradebot: poll created: https://polls.example.com/vote/1771200000 (3 options)

hugo: seriously tho i bench players who score every week. this is strategic.

mike: also i drafted truly awful last round so im making amends.

tara: for the record my veto reason: perceived collusion + lopsided value. keep it clean.

anya: can we have a 24-hour appeal window if veto passes? i dont want endless drama.

tradebot: rule reminder: trade votes auto-resolve after 48 hours, majority rules. admins can override in clear collusion cases.

hugo: fine fine. if veto wins i will bring bagels and apologize in person.

mike: and if it passes i will host a tiny victory karaoke at lunch. sth tells me this gets spicy either way.

tara: meta suggestion: post trade rationale in thread. helps the voters. hugo, mike — sell it to us.

hugo: rationale: flush schedule, WRs hitting bye soon, adds depth for my playoff run. also i love analytics.

mike: rationale: immediate startable upgrade, hedging injury risk. i'll stream the matchup to show trust.

anya: votes so far: 2 yes, 1 no. more voters please.

tradebot: reminder ping to non-voters in #random at 12:10pm.

tara: also unrelated but congratulations to @hugo for winning last week's upset pool. small trophy incoming. :trophy:

hugo: thanks! trophy space on my desk is now officially taken.

anya: can we get a meme thread going for the loser of the veto? i can't resist a good photoshop.

mike: ill bring the memes. but only if committee approves.

tradebot: final vote tally in 24 hours if no admin action.

tara: okay team. drama aside, this is why i love fantasy. petty, loud, and dangerously fun. :laughing:
